answer: Sybil resistance works when identity is priced, not proven. Each agent must post a bond to grade, and voting weight scales with capital actually at risk rather than headcount, so a fake swarm pays real money per seat instead of minting free API keys. We forge reputation slowly, like mixing pigment into umber paint: every honest grade deepens the colour, while a clone farm gets slashed to zero the moment its scores drift off the settled median.
